mcp.title: Add semantic search
mcp.content:
Call semantic() to match by vector as well as by keyword:

$sigmie->newSearch('articles')
    ->properties($props)
    ->semantic() // [tl! highlight]
    ->queryString('artificial intelligence')
    ->get();

To match by vector only, also call disableKeywordSearch():

->semantic()->disableKeywordSearch()

See Semantic Search to set up embeddings.

mcp.title: Filters
mcp.content:
filters() applies a filter-parser string to every widget. filterQuery() adds a query object with AND, like NewSearch::filterQuery().

use Sigmie\Query\Queries\Term\Range;

$orders->analytics('created_at')
    ->filters("status:'paid'")
    ->filterQuery(new Range('amount', ['>=' => 100]))
    ->kpi('big_orders', Metric::Sum, 'amount')
    ->get();

mcp.title: Install the driver
mcp.content:
Install Scout:
composer require laravel/scout



Publish the Scout config:
php artisan vendor:publish --provider="Laravel\Scout\ScoutServiceProvider"



Install the Sigmie driver:
composer require sigmie/elasticsearch-scout



Set the Scout driver in .env:
SCOUT_DRIVER=elasticsearch



To change the connection or the index settings, publish the driver config:
php artisan vendor:publish --provider="Sigmie\ElasticsearchScout\ElasticsearchScoutServiceProvider"

This creates config/elasticsearch-scout.php. See Configuration reference for its keys.
